_verificationNote.VERBATIM_MANDATED: FIXED (structurally) 2026-08-15: all FOUR paraphrases have been EMPTIED and marked VERBATIM_REQUIRED_NOT_TRANSCRIBED, and the engine now refuses to generate any CA contract until they are transcribed. A paraphrase is not a weaker clause — it is a non-compliant contract. Transcribe each character-for-character from the statute; do NOT reconstruct from memory. (1) requiredClauses[mechanics-lien-warning] — B&P 7159(e)(4), verbatim; the statutory warning continues past where the removed placeholder stopped, into prescribed language on preliminary notices and joint checks. (2) requiredClauses[right-to-cancel] — 7159(e)(6)(B)(i), verbatim, AT LEAST 12-POINT BOLDFACE; the removed placeholder's '(five business days if you are 65 or older)' belongs to the separate senior-citizen variant and must not be merged into the standard notice. (3) requiredClauses[cslb-notice] — 7159(e)(5), verbatim, AT LEAST 12-POINT TYPEFACE; the removed placeholder's hard-coded PO Box must not be carried forward without confirming it against current statutory text. (4) requiredClauses[downpayment-cap] — 7159(d)(8) prescribes a single capitalised sentence in AT LEAST 12-POINT BOLDFACE, not the multi-sentence prose that was encoded here. NOTE the down-payment RULE itself (lesser of $1,000 or 10%) was verified correct and is unchanged; only the text is missing.

dependsOn.homeImprovementThresholdCents: VERIFIED at $500. Statute reads 'exceeds five hundred dollars ($500)', so the trigger 'total >= threshold' is off by one — should be strictly greater than.
dependsOn.downpaymentCapRule: VERIFIED. B&P 7159(d)(8): lesser of $1,000 or 10 percent of the contract price. The RULE as encoded is correct; only the TEXT is non-compliant.
dependsOn.writtenContractClause: 7159(d) enumerates THIRTEEN required elements; the placeholder covers roughly two. The cite at requiredClauses[written-contract].statute says 7159(c) — that is the writing requirement; the contents obligation is 7159(d).
dependsOn.licenseDisplayRequired: VERIFIED true, but the authority is B&P 7030.5, which is NOT currently in citations[]. Add it. 7030.5 requires the licence number in all construction contracts, subcontracts and calls for bid, and all forms of advertising.
dependsOn.typographyRequirements: FIXED (recorded) 2026-08-15: the clause schema now carries a `formatting` object and all four CA typography requirements are recorded there (12-point boldface / 12-point typeface). RECORDING IS NOT RENDERING — no contract surface yet sets type size or weight per clause, so this remains a blocker for generation even once the text is transcribed.

_verificationNote.recheckCadence: Re-verify annually and after any legislative session amending B&P div. 3 ch. 9. The CSLB mailing address in the 7159(e)(5) notice can change without a statutory amendment.

requiredClauses.title: Written contract required
requiredClauses.text: UNVERIFIED — ATTORNEY REVIEW REQUIRED. [Template] This agreement for home improvement work over $500 is set out in writing and signed by both parties before any work begins, as California law requires. The contract price is stated on the face of this agreement, and no work outside this scope will be performed without a signed change order.
